title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.70: Fixed the Planned counter and card index numbers not refreshing when a Planned card is copied mid-combat (Music Box etc.) - the copy showed the original's #N and wasn't counted until the next Planned action. The views now re-sync as soon as the copy enters play.
